items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: And on the five piece, we had this fellow Joe Morris. Drum... Well he was the drummer... So he played drummer that was out there.

ctx.x: Yeah, well he played. We had a nice band and I kept up then sometime. I would give him a read section, Howard would bring me his folks. He had a big band too. Same man had Clifford Brown playing with him. Know Clifford? Yeah, I don't know him. So anyhow, he would sing and he had a nice voice. So we'd play all over. So Clifford, I got a little job for Dave Foster. About ten we played. And on the five piece, we had this fellow Joe Morris. Drum, the little boy, Lil Morris. The little drummer, he's shorty. He looked…
There's been a Morris, a bass player. That's his son, that's his son.
